name: panel
title: Panel
description: In-flow collapsible content container. A semantic <section> with a labeled header (h2/h3) and a body, optionally collapsible via a chevron in the header. Three variants — plain (in-page section), bordered (Card-flavored section), and inspector (a docked right-rail panel that can resize). The de-facto 'settings group' / 'inspector panel' primitive.
